answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the gale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
